# Check: upstream regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts

## Subject
Regional-indicator grapheme width handling for flag emoji during streaming.

## Upstream test count (approx)
5

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- treats partial flag grapheme as full-width to avoid streaming render drift
- wraps intermediate partial-flag list line before overflow
- treats all regional-indicator singleton graphemes as width 2
- keeps full flag pairs at width 2
- keeps common streaming emoji intermediates at stable width

## Upstream dependencies
visibleWidth, wrapTextWithAnsi from ../src/utils.js

## Upstream notes
Regression fix for streaming render drift when "🇨🇳" appears as "🇨" first. Partial flag graphemes (U+1F1E6–U+1F1FF) are measured as width 2 to match terminal rendering. Prevents stale characters on screen during streaming.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs
- possibly a dedicated grapheme/width test

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts (5 tests)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs (partial overlap on 1 test)

## MAPPED (partial)

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| treats partial flag grapheme as full-width (🇨 = 2) — half of test 1 | "treats isolated regional indicators as width 2" (🇨=2, 🇨🇳=2) |

## UNMAPPED

- Second half of upstream #1: `visibleWidth("      - 🇨")` must equal 10 (6 spaces + "- " + flag-width-2).
- Upstream #2 "wraps intermediate partial-flag list line before overflow": `wrap("      - 🇨", 9)` must produce 2 lines with widths 7 and 2.
- Upstream #3 "treats all regional-indicator singleton graphemes as width 2": iterate U+1F1E6..U+1F1FF and assert width 2 for every one.
- Upstream #4 "keeps full flag pairs at width 2": samples [🇯🇵, 🇺🇸, 🇬🇧, 🇨🇳, 🇩🇪, 🇫🇷] each width 2.
- Upstream #5 "keeps common streaming emoji intermediates at stable width": samples [👍, 👍🏻, ✅, ⚡, ⚡️, 👨, 👨‍💻, 🏳️‍🌈] each width 2.

Note: the streaming emoji intermediates test (#5) is the key regression — ensures width is stable across streaming intermediates (e.g., 👨 before 👨‍💻 arrives). If the Elixir implementation measures differently, this will fail and reveal a real drift risk.

## Action

One compliance ticket porting 4 missing tests and extending one.
